description: This file defines the PerformanceReviewAPI class, which serves as a REST API endpoint for managing performance reviews in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting performance review records, along with validation rules and request handling logic. The class interacts with underlying services and DAOs to perform CRUD operations on performance review data.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewAPI
classes.description: API class handling CRUD operations and validation for performance reviews, extending the Endpoint class. Implements methods for listing, creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting performance review records, with validation rules and request processing logic.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles retrieval of a list of performance reviews with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method, ensuring parameters are correct.

methods.name: getFilterParams
methods.description: Extracts and sets filter parameters from the request into the filter object.

methods.name: getFilterParamRules
methods.description: Returns validation rules for filtering parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new performance review record based on request data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a performance review.

methods.name: getCommonValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules used in create and update methods.

methods.name: setReviewParams
methods.description: Sets performance review properties based on request parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes performance review records by IDs provided in the request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete operation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single performance review record by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for retrieving a single record.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing performance review record.
